name: Byblos Bank Data Center / Byblos Tower B1 Data Center
notes: Byblos Bank announced inauguration 2019-06-24 at its Ashrafieh HQ; bank release describes it as the only Uptime Institute Tier III certified constructed facility in Lebanon; Uptime page confirms Byblos Tower B1 Data Center with client Byblos Bank s.a.l. Private bank facility, not public colocation; no MW/rack data published.

name: LFAIT Ras Beirut (LEB-DC #1)
developer: Lebanese For Advanced Information Technologies SARL (LFAIT)
notes: Directory lead: LEB-DC #1 in Ras Beirut (Kraitem); DataCenterMap lists LFAIT Ras Beirut; operator portal claims servers and VMware clusters across multiple datacenters (A for operator text) but no dedicated Ras Beirut facility page was found. Directory MW/sqm/Tier values are C-grade only and not copied into this record.

name: TerraNet Network Operations Center co-location
notes: TerraNet official product page offers customer server placement/co-location in its Network Operations Center with redundant UPS, automatic generators, climate control, secure access. RIPE lists TerraNet sal at Mdawar, Charles El-Helou Avenue, Nassar Center, Beirut. A for service claim; small NOC colo lead, no standalone facility specs/MW published.

name: Ogero institutional / backbone hosting
notes: A for Ogero identity/backbone role; no public commercial colocation/data-center specification page found, so any 'Ogero data center' facility spec is U. Ongoing diesel/fuel-driven outages (e.g. Beit Mery Central, Beirut outages) gate status across governorates; not a commercial DC record.

name: LFAIT Medyar
developer: Lebanese For Advanced Information Technologies SARL (LFAIT)
notes: Operator announcements reference 'Lebanon/Medyar DC' maintenance/migration; DataCenterMap lists LFAIT Medyar at Medyar, Dibbieh Rd, Shouf (Mount Lebanon). A for operator-owned location/service claims; directory power/space/Tier values remain C-grade and unverified. Commercial colo/hosting lead, strongest in Mount Lebanon.

name: Lebanon Digital Acceleration Project (P506791) - government community cloud / data center investments
developer: Government of Lebanon / World Bank (OMSAR-led implementation)
notes: World Bank project approved 2026-01-26; 2026-04-28 ISR lists Component 1 Digital Foundations at USD 87.5m with indicators for government community cloud, data-center PUE, and USD 11m private capital enabled by data-center investments. SEP: private investors will deploy the government community cloud platform in new and/or rehabilitated data centers (Associated Facilities). Pipeline/planned; no public site or operator yet. National scope.
